race.description: Road To Magic Millions Book Now Mdn Plate
race.comment: Intriguing maiden with a few promising ones resuming. Tough to split the top three, but starting with INVINCIBLE CHASE (6). She just missed on debut before being thrown in the deep to tackle the LR Oxlade Stakes. Didn't make an impression there in testing conditions but looks to have come back in great order, stripping fitter for two smart trials, in which he keeps Benny Thompson. Can return with a bang. DOUBLE COOL (4) has made more of a race day impression with the six runs under her belt, a majority of them in strong company. Has also put two sharp trials under her belt in readiness and looks sure to be very competitive fresh. MAKE ME GREAT (12) looks to have plenty of speed and can give a sight. SHOTPOINT (2) was only fair when resuming but should improve with that run under his belt and benefits at the weights with Newman claiming 3kgs. The inside draw should also give him a good look.
